## New York Lease-End Checklist for 2026-08-31

Media: Icon=https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/bootstrap-icons@1.11.3/icons/house.svg

A practical prep list for a tenant ending a 12-month lease in New York, with a **USD 2,100** security deposit and a goal of reducing cleaning and move-out disputes. This is a document-prep checklist, not legal advice.

## Move-Out Notice, Condition Record, and Deposit Evidence

Media: Icon=https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/bootstrap-icons@1.11.3/icons/calendar.svg

### 1) Move-out notice package
- Confirm the lease end date is **2026-08-31** and count back the notice deadline from the lease terms.
- Prepare a short written notice that includes:
  - Tenant name(s)
  - Apartment address and unit number
  - Lease end date: **2026-08-31**
  - Forwarding address for the deposit return
  - Date of notice and signature
- Send it by the method required in the lease, and keep proof of delivery.
- Save a PDF or screenshot of the final notice and mailing/email confirmation.

### 2) Apartment condition documentation
- Take dated photos and short videos of every room after cleaning, with lights on.
- Capture:
  - Floors, walls, ceilings, windows, doors, appliances, bathroom fixtures, closets, and inside cabinets
  - Any existing damage, stains, chips, or wear before move-out
  - Meter readings if applicable
- Make sure each image is clearly tied to a room and date.
- Keep a simple room-by-room log of what was cleaned and what was already worn or damaged.

### 3) Cleaning and move-out protection file
- Keep receipts for professional cleaning, trash removal, carpet cleaning, or repairs you paid for.
- Save before-and-after photos of any spot cleaning or repair work.
- If you return keys, fobs, parking passes, or mailbox keys, get a written handoff confirmation.
- Do a final walkthrough if possible and note who was present and what was discussed.

### 4) Deposit dispute evidence folder
- Create one folder with:
  - Signed lease and any addenda
  - Security deposit receipt or proof of payment for **USD 2,100**
  - Move-out notice and delivery proof
  - Move-out photos/videos
  - Cleaning receipts and contractor invoices
  - Key return proof
  - Email/text messages with the landlord or property manager
  - A timeline of events with dates
- Keep both cloud and local backups.
- Rename files clearly so they are easy to find later.

### 5) Clauses to review before sending anything
- Notice requirement: how many days of notice are required and how it must be delivered.
- Surrender clause: what counts as returning possession of the apartment.
- Cleaning clause: whether the lease requires professional cleaning or only “broom clean” condition.
- Repair/damage clause: what counts as normal wear and tear versus tenant damage.
- Key return clause: where and when keys must be returned.
- Deposit clause: what deductions are allowed and where the deposit must be sent.
- Move-out inspection clause: whether the landlord can inspect before or after move-out and whether you can attend.
- Forwarding address clause: whether the lease requires a written forwarding address for deposit return.

### 6) Final day checklist
- Remove all belongings and trash.
- Take final dated photos of every room after the unit is empty.
- Turn off lights, lock windows, and leave the unit in the required condition.
- Return keys exactly as instructed.
- Send a final email confirming move-out and your forwarding address.
- Save copies of everything in one place.

## Deposit-Proof Document Set

Media: Icon=https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/bootstrap-icons@1.11.3/icons/clipboard-check.svg

| Item | What to keep | Why it matters |
|---|---|---|
| Lease and addenda | Signed lease, renewal, house rules | Shows notice, cleaning, and deposit terms |
| Move-out notice | Final notice + delivery proof | Proves you ended the tenancy properly |
| Condition evidence | Dated photos and videos | Helps dispute cleaning or damage claims |
| Payment records | Deposit proof, rent receipts, cleaning invoices | Shows what you paid and when |
| Handoff proof | Key return receipt, walkthrough notes | Helps prove surrender of the apartment |
| Communications | Emails, texts, letters | Creates a timeline if charges are disputed |
